full_judgment: 2. Relevant facts for the purpose of the case are that opposite party No. 1 as plaintiff instituted a suit in the Court of the Munsif, Gaibandha Sadar, being Other Class Suit No. 53 of 1987 for declaration of his title in the suit land measuring 3.34 acres recorded in C.S. Khatian No. 59 of Monza Chakdurgapur, fully described in schedule 'Ka' to the plaint. His case is that his father Poyer Maraud Mondal and lulu Powchhani Bibi were the owners of the suit properly and they possessed the same. The plaintiff took palls of the suit and from his father Poyer Maraud Mondal and lulu Pawchhani Bibi and since the said settlement he has been owning and possessing the same on payment of rent to the landlords During the R.S. operation the suit land was not recorded in his name due to the mistake of the survey officials and hence the suit for removing the could cast over his title.
